title: Create: Spinning Döners
description: a create addon which adds döners
body:
THIS MOD REQUIRES CREATE! (omg)

## BLOCKS:

- Döner Spinner: a 2-block tall kinetic machine that spins meat on a shaft. Insert a raw full döner by right-clicking the upper half or by using a funnel on the input port. apply heat from a Sideways Heater to cook it. supply a redstone signal to auto-chop.
    
- Sideways Heater: a kinetic heater that must be placed facing the Döner Spinner to cook the meat. requires atleast 64 RPM to reach cooking temperature.
    
- Döner Station: a kinetic heater which cooks up raw full döners and outputs cooked full döners via funnels. requires atleast 64 RPM to reach cooking temperature.
    

also dont confuse the inputs and outputs on the spinner and on the station

- input port = upward arrow, brighter color (raw döners go in here via funnel)
- output port = downward arrow, darker color (cooked pieces/cooked full döner come out via funnel)

all blocks have Ponder scenes explaining their mechanics

## RECIPES:

use jei (too lazy, sorry)
